name: Rockstor
author: Netlens
description: Shows a Rockstor NAS (version 5 and newer) as a host with the Docker containers of its installed Rock-ons as guests: state, version and the ports each container publishes, matched to the devices on your network. Reads through Rockstor's REST API over HTTPS, read-only.

info.title: Set up a user for Netlens on the Rockstor
info.text: Rockstor's REST API takes the user name and password of a Rockstor web user (HTTP Basic over HTTPS). Create a user of its own: in the Rockstor web page open System > Users > Add a new user, name it netlens with a long random password, and keep its other rights minimal; the plugin only reads. Enter the address (https://<NAS address>; Rockstor uses a self-signed certificate until you install your own, so leave 'Verify TLS certificate' off) and the credentials in Netlens. Rock-ons that are not installed are ignored.
info.code:
# Rockstor web page: System > Users > Add a new user
#   Username: netlens   (a long, random password)
# In Netlens: address https://<NAS address>, that user name and password

config.label: Rockstor NAS systems
config.help: One line per Rockstor: its address (https://192.168.0.30) and the user name and password of the Netlens user.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Leave this off while the NAS uses its own self-signed certificate.

dashboard.title: Rockstor Rock-ons
dashboard.about: Running and stopped containers of the Rock-ons installed on your Rockstor NAS.
